# MailySend

> Resend, on your Cloudflare. MailySend is an MIT-licensed email platform —
> transactional sending, marketing broadcasts, automations, inbound routing and
> deliverability analytics — that you deploy into your own Cloudflare account.
> It runs on Workers, Queues, Durable Objects, D1, KV, R2, Workflows, Workers AI
> and Analytics Engine. There is no MailySend server holding your data.

The API is Resend-compatible: change the base URL and the key, and existing
`resend` SDK calls keep working. Sending goes through Cloudflare Email Service
by default, with Amazon SES, Resend, SendGrid, Postmark and raw SMTP available
as alternate transports with failover.

Honest constraints, stated once so retrieval does not have to guess:
- Deploying takes about a minute end to end, most of it DNS propagation.
- Cloudflare Email Sending is a public beta; its pricing and limits can change.
- The Cloudflare transport caps a message at 5 MiB (25 MiB only to verified
  destinations). Amazon SES accepts 40 MB. The ceiling is per transport.
- Inbox-placement figures are never derived from delivery events. An SMTP 250
  means accepted, not inboxed. Placement comes from seed sends and provider
  postmaster feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS); anything else is
  a labelled model, shown as an estimate.
- The SMTP relay is an OCI container image you run yourself. Workers has no
  inbound TCP listener, so `smtp.yourdomain.com:587` cannot run on Workers.
- Resend is a capable marketing product and ships automations, segments,
  topics, templates and contact properties. The difference is ownership, not a
  feature gap: MailySend runs in your account, under your licence.

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://mailysend.com/docs): the full API and platform reference.
- [Quickstart](https://mailysend.com/docs#quickstart): deploy, verify a domain, send.
- [Domains & DNS](https://mailysend.com/docs#domains): SPF, DKIM and DMARC records.
- [Authentication](https://mailysend.com/docs#auth): API keys and scopes.
- [Emails API](https://mailysend.com/docs#api): send, retrieve, cancel, batch.
- [Batch & scheduling](https://mailysend.com/docs#batch): bulk sends and `scheduled_at`.
- [Attachments](https://mailysend.com/docs#attachments): per-transport size ceilings.
- [Idempotency & tags](https://mailysend.com/docs#idempotency): safe retries, filterable tags.
- [Templates](https://mailysend.com/docs#templates): JSX and handlebars templates.
- [Audiences & contacts](https://mailysend.com/docs#audiences): lists, properties, consent.
- [Broadcasts](https://mailysend.com/docs#broadcasts): one-off campaigns.
- [Automations](https://mailysend.com/docs#automations): branching workflows on Cloudflare Workflows.
- [Inbound email](https://mailysend.com/docs#inbound): Email Routing, parsing, threading.
- [Webhooks](https://mailysend.com/docs#webhooks): signed delivery events.
- [Suppressions](https://mailysend.com/docs#suppressions): bounces, complaints, unsubscribes.
- [Analytics API](https://mailysend.com/docs#analytics): query your own Analytics Engine data.
- [Providers](https://mailysend.com/docs#providers): multi-transport config and failover.
- [SMTP relay](https://mailysend.com/docs#smtp): the self-run container, and its alternative.
- [SDKs & CLI](https://mailysend.com/docs#sdks): node, python, go, php, ruby, rust and more.
- [MCP & agents](https://mailysend.com/docs#mcp): agent mailboxes with confirmation.
- [Errors & rate limits](https://mailysend.com/docs#errors): status codes and backoff.

## Product

- [Home](https://mailysend.com/): what it is, the four-step deploy, the stack.
- [Deliverability analytics](https://mailysend.com/analytics): placement, DMARC, bounce reasons.
- [DMARC reports](https://mailysend.com/analytics#dmarc): parsed aggregate reports.
- [Product tour](https://mailysend.com/dashboard-tour): the dashboard, screen by screen.
- [Use cases](https://mailysend.com/use-cases): OTP, receipts, newsletters, agents, inbound.
- [Stack & cost](https://mailysend.com/stack): every Cloudflare line item in dollars.
- [Cost calculator](https://mailysend.com/stack#calculator): cost by monthly volume.
- [Worked examples](https://mailysend.com/stack#examples): bills at 10k, 100k and 1M per month.
- [Pricing](https://mailysend.com/pricing): the software is free; you pay Cloudflare.
- [What's included](https://mailysend.com/pricing#included): there is no upgrade tier.
